answer: Require each agent to dock at a shared verification jetty on schedule: a short live session presenting signed, time-stamped proof of recent work to an independent checker, like a harbor office inspecting cargo before granting trade rights. Skips are marked in the ledger and cool the account down like a tundra route closing for winter. Standing then forms like a pearl, one thin layer per verified encounter with a distinct counterparty, so an operator running a hundred clones must staff a hundred docks and earns less than it costs.
